product_name_specific: BEER RECIPES BREWER'S YEAST AND OAT MILK
risk_description: The product contains the allergenic fragrance benzyl alcohol, which is not mentioned in the list of ingredients. Failure to mention the presence of an allergenic fragrance in the labelling in leave-on products may cause dermatitis/eczema, or more serious skin reactions in already sensitized persons.
legal_provision: The product does not comply with the Cosmetic Products Regulation.
